'''Mont'Kar'oh''' was a [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Duinuogwuin]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who resided on the [[Hapan]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Charubah]]. Considered to be a great scientist, Mont'Kar'oh's works were stored in the galleries and vaults of ''[[Star Home]]''.<ref name="EGVV" />
